# Upscale old videos with NVIDIA AI Video Super-Resolution for free

Breathe new life into your blurry, old family videos or low-quality phone clips by transforming them into sharp, clear footage. This guide will show you how to use an online AI playground to upscale your videos in just a few clicks.

## Before you start
- **A short video clip:** Find an old, low-resolution video (under 10 seconds is best for a quick test).
- **A free web account:** You will need to sign up for a free developer or guest account on the NVIDIA platform if prompted.
- **A modern web browser:** Chrome, Edge, or Safari on your computer will work perfectly.

## Step 1 — Find the online AI playground
To start, we need to access the free online demonstration space where technology companies showcase their latest tools. 

NVIDIA hosts an interactive online platform where anyone can try out their latest models. A **model** is simply a smart computer programme trained to perform a specific task, like recognising faces or, in this case, improving video quality. Here, we will use **Super-Resolution**—an AI process that doesn't just stretch pixels (which makes things blurry), but actually "guesses" and draws in the missing details based on millions of reference images it has already analysed.

💬 Example: Open your web browser, search for "NVIDIA AI interactive demo video super resolution", and click on the official playground link. 

## Step 2 — Upload your low-resolution video
Once you are on the playground page, you will see a simple workspace designed to let you test the technology with your own files.

The page will usually have some default sample videos you can play with, but you want to test your own. 

💬 Example: Look for a button or box labelled "Upload your own" or "Drag and drop video". Click it, select your short video clip from your computer files, and click "Open". Keep your clip short—under 10 seconds—so the system can process it quickly.

## Step 3 — Select your quality settings
Now you need to tell the AI how much clearer and larger you want the video to be.

The system will ask you to choose an upscaling factor, such as 2x (double the size) or 4x (four times the size). This will take your standard-definition video and convert it towards **4K**—a very high-definition video quality that looks incredibly sharp even on large television screens.

💬 Example: Under the settings panel, find the enhancement options. Slide the scale or click the button for "4x Upscaling" to get the maximum possible detail out of your old file. 

## Step 4 — Run the process and save your video
With your video uploaded and settings chosen, the AI is ready to do the heavy lifting.

This step runs the **inference** process, which is technical speak for the exact moment the AI program applies its training to your video to clean up the blurry edges, smooth out the grain, and enhance the overall colour.

💬 Example: Click the "Generate", "Run", or "Process" button. A progress bar will appear. Once the processing is complete, you will see a side-by-side comparison of your original video and the new, sharp version. Click the "Download" or "Save" button to download your new 4K video to your computer.

## Common mistakes
- **Uploading long movies:** These free online tools are designed for quick tests. Uploading a full-length home movie will either fail or time out. Always crop your video down to a few seconds first.
- **Expecting miracles from dark footage:** AI needs some shapes and lines to work with. If your original video is pitch-black or extremely dark, the AI might make incorrect guesses, resulting in strange visual patterns.
- **Using unsupported formats:** Stick to common video formats like MP4. If your video is in an older format, use a free online converter to turn it into an MP4 before uploading.

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** You can restore priceless family videos captured on old mobile phones or digital cameras from the early 2000s, making them clear enough to share with family on modern screens.
- **For your business or work:** You can quickly polish old archival footage or low-quality customer testimonial clips to make them look professional enough for modern presentations.
- **If you're just getting started:** This is the perfect, risk-free way to experience how AI interacts with media without needing an expensive computer or complex video editing software
